newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian launches int'l guaranteed product.
newsitem.headline: Canadian launches int'l guaranteed product.

text.p: Canadian Air Cargo said it will introduce a new international, flight-specific express product with a money back guarantee on October 1.
If the shipment does not make it out on the flight booked, it will be carried for free on the next one, the airline said.
Called International Guaranteed, it will allow shippers to book shipments up to four hours prior to departure and tender them up to two hours to takeoff on all of Canadian's interncontinental routes.
Like the domestic product it is modelled on, Guaranteed International provides booking confirmation, along with other priority and loading features, the airline said.

"We at Canadian ... are again prepared to take the lead in meeting our customer's need for time-definite, guaranteed movement,"said Canadian's vice-president of cargo,Barry Rempel. --Air Cargo Newsroom +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
